Gujarati Festivals 2026 / ગુજરાતી કૅલેન્ડર 2026

गुजराती कैलेंडर विक्रम संवत पर आधारित चन्द्र-सौर कैलेंडर है। इसका नया साल दिवाली के अगले दिन, कार्तिक शुक्ल प्रतिपदा (बेस्तु वरस) से शुरू होता है। नीचे 2026 के गुजराती त्योहार और व्रत हैं।

The Gujarati calendar (ગુજરાતી કૅલેન્ડર) is a lunisolar calendar based on Vikram Samvat. Months run from new moon to new moon (Amanta), and the year begins on Kartik Shukla Pratipada, the day after Diwali. The dates below are the festivals and vrats of 2026, worked out for Delhi (IST).

Gujarati New Year (Bestu Varas) / બેસતું વર્ષ

The Gujarati New Year falls on 10 November 2026 and begins Vikram Samvat 2083. Vikram Samvat runs 57 years ahead of the Gregorian year, and the Gujarati year starts in Kartak instead of Chaitra. In 2026 it is Adhik Jyeshtha, from about 17 May to 15 June. An Adhik Mahino (extra month) is added about every 30 months to keep the lunar months in step with the seasons.

Popular Gujarati festivals and vrats

  • Uttarayana: Makara Sankranti, the kite festival.
  • Navratri and Sharad Purnima: nine nights of garba, then the Kojagari full moon.
  • Diwali and Bestu Varas: Dhanteras, Kali Chaudas, Lakshmi Puja and the new year on the next day.
  • Jaya Parvati and Gauri Vrat: fasts of young girls in Ashadh.
  • Randhan Chhath, Shitala Satam and Nag Pancham: the three days before Janmashtami.
  • Sankashta, Ekadashi and Chandra Darshana: the monthly fasts and moon sightings.

Where two traditions differ, an Ekadashi is shown on both days as Gauna and Vaishnava. Eclipses are shown for 2026 only. For other dates, see the Hindu Calendar, Indian Holidays and the Aaj ka Panchang.

Gujarati Festivals FAQs

When is the Gujarati New Year in 2026?

The Gujarati New Year (Bestu Varas) is on 10 November 2026, the day after Diwali.

When is Uttarayana in 2026?

Uttarayana (Makara Sankranti) is on 14 January 2026.

When is Diwali in 2026?

Diwali (Lakshmi Puja) is on 8 November 2026.

What is Chandra Darshana?

It is the first sighting of the new Moon after Amavasya, in the evening of Shukla Dwitiya. Many families offer prayers and some begin fasts on this day.

Dates are for Delhi (IST) and may differ by a day in other cities or traditions. Confirm important festivals with your family pandit.
